verdict.rationale: DeepInfra advertises a zero-retention policy for inputs/outputs and SOC 2/ISO 27001 certification, suggesting data isn't stored by default, which touches on privacy posture. However, there is no explicit mention of a telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting, dashboard toggle, or analytics control for users. missing for 10: explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out mechanism, documentation distinguishing telemetry from data retention, independent confirmation of no tracking.
